WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    lower(btrim(COALESCE($1::text, ''))) AS accion,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE($2::text, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS telegram_digits,
    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE($3::text, '')), '') AS name_in,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE($4::text, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint AS caller_id,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE($5::text, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS phone_digits,
    NULLIF(lower(btrim(COALESCE($6::text, ''))), '') AS team_tag,
    CASE lower(btrim(COALESCE($7::text, '')))
      WHEN 'true' THEN true WHEN 't' THEN true WHEN '1' THEN true
      WHEN 'si' THEN true WHEN 'sí' THEN true WHEN 'yes' THEN true WHEN 'activo' THEN true
      WHEN 'false' THEN false WHEN 'f' THEN false WHEN '0' THEN false
      WHEN 'no' THEN false WHEN 'inactivo' THEN false
      ELSE NULL
    END AS active,
    CASE lower(btrim(COALESCE($8::text, '')))
      WHEN 'true' THEN true WHEN 't' THEN true WHEN '1' THEN true
      WHEN 'si' THEN true WHEN 'sí' THEN true WHEN 'yes' THEN true
      WHEN 'false' THEN false WHEN 'f' THEN false WHEN '0' THEN false
      WHEN 'no' THEN false
      ELSE NULL
    END AS skip_followup,
    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE($9::text, '')), '') AS notes
),
params AS (
  SELECT
    r.accion,
    COALESCE(
      r.telegram_digits::bigint,
      (
        SELECT q.telegram_user_id
        FROM assistant_access_requests q
        WHERE r.phone_digits IS NOT NULL
          AND q.telegram_user_id = r.phone_digits::bigint
      ),
      (
        SELECT t.phone::bigint
        FROM team_phones t
        WHERE r.telegram_digits IS NULL
          AND r.phone_digits IS NOT NULL
          AND t.phone = r.phone_digits
          AND t.telegram_user_id IS NULL
          AND t.phone !~ '^58'
          AND t.phone !~ '^4'
          AND char_length(t.phone) BETWEEN 6 AND 10
      )
    ) AS telegram_user_id,
    COALESCE(
      CASE
        WHEN r.name_in IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN lower(r.name_in) IN ('usuario telegram', 'lista negra') THEN NULL
        ELSE r.name_in
      END,
      (
        SELECT NULLIF(btrim(q.display_name), '')
        FROM assistant_access_requests q
        WHERE q.telegram_user_id = COALESCE(
          r.telegram_digits::bigint,
          CASE WHEN r.phone_digits IS NOT NULL THEN r.phone_digits::bigint END
        )
      )
    ) AS name_raw,
    r.caller_id,
    CASE
      WHEN r.phone_digits IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN r.telegram_digits IS NOT NULL AND r.phone_digits = r.telegram_digits THEN NULL
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM assistant_access_requests q
        WHERE q.telegram_user_id = r.phone_digits::bigint
      ) THEN NULL
      WHEN r.phone_digits !~ '^58' AND r.phone_digits !~ '^4'
        AND char_length(r.phone_digits) BETWEEN 6 AND 10
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM team_phones t
          WHERE t.phone = r.phone_digits AND t.telegram_user_id IS NULL
        ) THEN NULL
      ELSE r.phone_digits
    END AS phone,
    r.team_tag,
    r.active,
    r.skip_followup,
    r.notes
  FROM raw r
),
caller AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM team_phones d
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE d.telegram_user_id = p.caller_id
    AND d.team_tag = 'desarrollo'
    AND d.assistant_enabled
    AND assistant_may(p.caller_id, 'gestionar_acceso_asistente')
),
by_id AS (
  SELECT t.id
  FROM team_phones t
  JOIN params p ON t.telegram_user_id = p.telegram_user_id
  WHERE p.telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL
),
by_phone AS (
  SELECT t.id
  FROM team_phones t
  JOIN params p ON t.phone = p.phone
  WHERE p.phone IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM by_id)
),
by_misplaced AS (
  SELECT t.id
  FROM team_phones t
  JOIN params p ON t.phone = p.telegram_user_id::text
  WHERE p.telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND t.telegram_user_id IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM by_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM by_phone)
),
by_name AS (
  SELECT t.id
  FROM team_phones t
  JOIN params p ON (
    lower(btrim(t.name)) = lower(regexp_replace(btrim(p.name_raw), '[%_]', '', 'g'))
    OR lower(btrim(t.name)) LIKE lower(regexp_replace(btrim(p.name_raw), '[%_]', '', 'g')) || ' %'
  )
  WHERE p.name_raw IS NOT NULL
    AND char_length(regexp_replace(btrim(p.name_raw), '[%_]', '', 'g')) >= 3
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM by_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM by_phone)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM by_misplaced)
    AND (
      t.telegram_user_id IS NULL
      OR p.telegram_user_id IS NULL
      OR t.telegram_user_id = p.telegram_user_id
    )
),
picked AS (
  SELECT id FROM by_id
  UNION ALL SELECT id FROM by_phone
  UNION ALL SELECT id FROM by_misplaced
  UNION ALL SELECT id FROM by_name
),
gate AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM caller) THEN 'solo_desarrollador'
    WHEN p.accion NOT IN (
      'autorizar', 'agregar', 'alta', 'actualizar', 'completar',
      'revocar', 'quitar', 'desactivar'
    ) THEN 'accion_invalida'
    WHEN p.accion IN ('revocar', 'quitar', 'desactivar') AND p.telegram_user_id IS NULL THEN 'id_invalido'
    WHEN p.accion IN ('autorizar', 'agregar', 'alta', 'actualizar', 'completar')
      AND p.telegram_user_id IS NULL AND p.phone IS NULL AND p.name_raw IS NULL THEN 'id_invalido'
    WHEN p.team_tag IS NOT NULL AND p.team_tag NOT IN ('equipo_ventas', 'asesora', 'asistente') THEN 'tag_invalido'
    WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM by_name) > 1 THEN 'nombre_ambiguo'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM team_phones t
      JOIN params px ON t.phone = px.phone
      WHERE px.phone IS NOT NULL
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM by_id)
        AND t.id <> (SELECT id FROM by_id LIMIT 1)
    ) THEN 'telefono_en_uso'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM team_phones t
      JOIN params px ON t.telegram_user_id = px.telegram_user_id
      WHERE px.telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM by_phone)
        AND t.id <> (SELECT id FROM by_phone LIMIT 1)
    ) THEN 'id_en_otra_persona'
    WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM picked) = 0
      AND p.name_raw IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM team_phones t
        JOIN params px ON (
          lower(btrim(t.name)) = lower(regexp_replace(btrim(px.name_raw), '[%_]', '', 'g'))
          OR lower(btrim(t.name)) LIKE lower(regexp_replace(btrim(px.name_raw), '[%_]', '', 'g')) || ' %'
        )
        WHERE px.telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL
          AND t.telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL
          AND t.telegram_user_id <> px.telegram_user_id
      ) THEN 'ya_tiene_otro_id'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS bloqueo
  FROM params p
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE team_phones t SET
    telegram_user_id = COALESCE(p.telegram_user_id, t.telegram_user_id),
    assistant_enabled = true,
    name = CASE
      WHEN t.team_tag = 'desarrollo' OR p.name_raw IS NULL THEN t.name
      WHEN lower(btrim(t.name)) LIKE lower(regexp_replace(btrim(p.name_raw), '[%_]', '', 'g')) || ' %' THEN t.name
      WHEN t.name IN ('Usuario Telegram', 'Lista negra') THEN p.name_raw
      WHEN char_length(btrim(p.name_raw)) >= char_length(btrim(t.name)) THEN p.name_raw
      ELSE t.name
    END,
    phone = CASE
      WHEN p.phone IS NOT NULL AND t.team_tag <> 'desarrollo' THEN p.phone
      WHEN p.telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL AND t.phone = p.telegram_user_id::text THEN NULL
      ELSE t.phone
    END,
    team_tag = CASE
      WHEN p.team_tag IS NOT NULL AND t.team_tag <> 'desarrollo' THEN p.team_tag
      ELSE t.team_tag
    END,
    active = CASE
      WHEN p.active IS NOT NULL AND t.team_tag <> 'desarrollo' THEN p.active
      ELSE t.active
    END,
    skip_followup = CASE
      WHEN p.skip_followup IS NOT NULL AND t.team_tag <> 'desarrollo' THEN p.skip_followup
      ELSE t.skip_followup
    END,
    notes = CASE
      WHEN p.notes IS NOT NULL AND t.team_tag <> 'desarrollo' THEN p.notes
      ELSE t.notes
    END,
    updated_at = now()
  FROM params p
  WHERE (SELECT bloqueo FROM gate) IS NULL
    AND p.accion IN ('autorizar', 'agregar', 'alta', 'actualizar', 'completar')
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM picked) = 1
    AND t.id = (SELECT id FROM picked LIMIT 1)
  RETURNING
    t.telegram_user_id, t.name, t.phone, t.team_tag, t.active, t.skip_followup,
    t.assistant_enabled, 'actualizado'::text AS resultado
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO team_phones (
    phone, name, team_tag, active, skip_followup, assistant_enabled, telegram_user_id, notes
  )
  SELECT
    p.phone,
    COALESCE(p.name_raw, 'Usuario Telegram'),
    COALESCE(p.team_tag, 'asistente'),
    COALESCE(p.active, false),
    COALESCE(p.skip_followup, false),
    true,
    p.telegram_user_id,
    COALESCE(p.notes, 'Alta desde el asistente')
  FROM params p
  WHERE (SELECT bloqueo FROM gate) IS NULL
    AND p.accion IN ('autorizar', 'agregar', 'alta', 'actualizar', 'completar')
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM picked) = 0
    AND (p.telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL OR p.phone IS NOT NULL)
  RETURNING
    telegram_user_id, name, phone, team_tag, active, skip_followup,
    assistant_enabled, 'alta'::text AS resultado
),
revoked AS (
  UPDATE team_phones t SET
    assistant_enabled = false,
    updated_at = now()
  FROM params p
  WHERE (SELECT bloqueo FROM gate) IS NULL
    AND p.accion IN ('revocar', 'quitar', 'desactivar')
    AND p.telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND t.telegram_user_id = p.telegram_user_id
    AND t.team_tag <> 'desarrollo'
  RETURNING
    t.telegram_user_id, t.name, t.phone, t.team_tag, t.active, t.skip_followup,
    t.assistant_enabled, 'revocado'::text AS resultado
),
blocked AS (
  SELECT
    p.telegram_user_id,
    COALESCE(p.name_raw, '') AS name,
    p.phone,
    p.team_tag,
    p.active,
    p.skip_followup,
    false AS assistant_enabled,
    COALESCE(g.bloqueo, 'sin_cambios') AS resultado
  FROM params p
  CROSS JOIN gate g
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM revoked)
),
touch_request AS (
  UPDATE assistant_access_requests q
  SET status = 'granted', updated_at = now()
  WHERE q.telegram_user_id IN (
    SELECT telegram_user_id FROM updated
    UNION ALL
    SELECT telegram_user_id FROM inserted
  )
  RETURNING q.telegram_user_id
)
SELECT telegram_user_id, name, phone, team_tag, active, skip_followup, assistant_enabled, resultado FROM updated
UNION ALL
SELECT telegram_user_id, name, phone, team_tag, active, skip_followup, assistant_enabled, resultado FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT telegram_user_id, name, phone, team_tag, active, skip_followup, assistant_enabled, resultado FROM revoked
UNION ALL
SELECT telegram_user_id, name, phone, team_tag, active, skip_followup, assistant_enabled, resultado FROM blocked;

## Autorizar y avisar
Lo llama gestionar_acceso_asistente del flujo 01.

1. Importa este flujo y publicalo.
2. Copia su id.
3. UPDATE app_config SET config_value = '<id>' WHERE config_key = 'workflow_07_id';
4. Reimporta el 01.

El alta usa assistant_access_requests si el nombre no viene. El id de Telegram no se guarda como telefono. Si el alta o la actualizacion tiene telegram_user_id, este flujo manda el aviso.
